_instructions: Per-team injury data for all projected 2026 NCAA Tournament teams. impact: 'star' | 'starter' | 'rotation'. status: 'out' | 'questionable' | 'limited'. injury_date: ISO date or null. projected_return: 'season-ending' | 'R1' | 'R2' | 'Sweet16' | 'Final Four' | 'unknown' | null.
_note: Update questionable/limited entries from official NCAA player availability reports (due 9pm venue time night before each game). Some teams had no injury news after dedicated searches — marked with verified_clean: true.
